title: Scalable and Versatile Identification for Hierarchical Structural Causal Models: A New Look at Project STAR
abstract: arXiv:2608.24500v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The STAR (Student-Teacher Achievement Ratio) experiment (1985, Tennessee, USA) is a landmark hierarchical dataset designed to assess the impact of class size on student outcomes, with observations nested within classes. To encode class-level interventions in such hierarchical settings, we develop a complete, scalable, open-source pipeline for Hierarchical Structural Causal Models (HSCM) that bridges symbolic identification and practical estimation. Our approach integrates graph transformations, pyAgrum's do-calculus for automatic identification of causal effects, adaptation of symbolic expression into closed-form HSCM formulas, and numerical estimation from fitted local probability models. A key innovation is our adapted Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), which decomposes pyAgrum's identified formulas into independent density, expectation, and marginalization tasks, enabling parallel and scalable computation. We validate the pipeline on canon

translated_title: 可扩展且通用的分层结构因果模型识别：对项目STAR的新审视
translated_abstract: 摘要：STAR（学生-教师比例实验）实验（1985年，美国田纳西州）是一个具有里程碑意义的分层数据集，旨在评估班级规模对学生成绩的影响，其中观测数据嵌套在班级内。为了在分层环境中编码班级层面的干预，我们开发了一个完整、可扩展、开源的管道，用于分层结构因果模型（HSCM），该管道弥合了符号识别与实际估计之间的鸿沟。我们的方法整合了图变换、pyAgrum的do-演算用于因果效应的自动识别、将符号表达式适配为闭式HSCM公式，以及从拟合的局部概率模型进行数值估计。一个关键创新是我们适配的抽象语法树（AST），它将pyAgrum识别出的公式分解为独立的密度、期望和边缘化任务，从而实现并行和可扩展的计算。我们在经典数据集上验证了该管道。
tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展且通用的开源管道，用于分层结构因果模型的识别和估计，其核心创新是通过适配的抽象语法树将识别公式分解为并行任务，从而高效处理嵌套数据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a scalable and versatile open-source pipeline for identifying and estimating hierarchical structural causal models, with a key innovation of decomposing identified formulas into parallel tasks via an adapted abstract syntax tree, enabling efficient processing of nested data.
